description: Visible interface work: screens, components, layout, styling and copy shown to people. A preview is approved before integration, and the integrated screen is compared against it.

exemplars.what: Screens or components in the repo, or a reference gallery the item names, that already look the way the result should; cite each one and say what to take from it.

proposalArtifact.name: preview
proposalArtifact.what: An isolated preview of the component or screen with real data or clearly labelled sample data, at the target width.

frozenBaseline: The approved preview: its block order, relative sizes, copy and locale.
